capabilities: Triage saved clippings into read/skim/keep/skip verdicts
Generate curated notes with key ideas and next steps
Gather reusable material into a Toolbox
Flag incomplete saves needing full text
Recover full text from source webpages
extras: Free and open-source (MIT). Requires a connected LLM; hosted providers may charge (default estimate US$3/month, 100-item daily limit) while Ollama/LM Studio allow offline use. Obsidian must stay open to process the queue. AI verdicts and summaries can be wrong, and PDF/image/video content is outside the Markdown workflow.
problem: People save more articles, posts, and research than they can read, so backlogs pile up with no way to decide what is worth reading.

relations.evidence: X expansion via FxTwitter and GitHub repository enrichment are separate opt-ins.

requires.name: LLM provider API key (DeepSeek default; Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter also supported)
Ollama or LM Studio for local/offline models

summary: AI-powered reading triage plugin that ranks saved Markdown clippings by reading value and turns useful ideas into linked notes.
